question: What claim about the transmission of the teaching of the Mothers is at stake in stating that it was told again by the sky-movers?
premises: A teaching concerning the Mothers exists.
It was told by the sky-movers.
This is addressed to the goddess and beloved one.
inference: The teaching of the Mothers is presented as having been transmitted again through the sky-movers.
uncertainties: The content of that teaching is not given in this verse.
plain_english: Again, O goddess, O beloved one, the teaching of the Mothers was told by the sky-movers.
